name: Peer-to-peer rental index: NVIDIA H200 SXM (per-GPU-hour, verified hosts)
price_basis: USD per GPU-HOUR for the GPU component, verified peer-to-peer hosts, 8-GPU bundles, observed 2026-10-03. Asking rate, NOT a realised rental. Excludes storage and SLA premium.
notes: OBSERVATION DATE 2026-10-03. Source sup-price-vast-rental-api. BAND: n=9 verified 8-GPU H200 hosts, range $3.6845-$6.0540/GPU-hr, median $5.0005; n=7 single-GPU hosts, range $3.5556-$5.1213, median $3.5556. n=7 for the 1-GPU side is thin, which is why price_usd uses the 8-GPU median. H200/H100 same-platform ratio, DERIVED: $5.0005/$2.3335 = 2.14x per GPU-hour at matched 8-GPU bundle size. Read this as a rental ratio only. It is NOT a hardware price ratio and must not be turned into one: an H200's premium in the rental market reflects 141GB HBM3e and rental scarcity, not what the card is worth to buy.
